messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant. Always respond in 2-5 sentences.
hey, i'm doing some research for an econ paper. can u tell me what the main reasons are for the increase in wealth inequality in the US over the last 40 years?

One major driver of US wealth inequality is the decline of organized labor and the resulting power shift favoring capital over labor in the economy.  Advancements in technology and globalization have also favored highly skilled, high-earning individuals in certain sectors, while simultaneously driving down the value of traditional labor for lower- and middle-income workers. Additionally, changes in tax policy and the increasing political power of the wealthy have allowed for the preferential accumulation and preservation of capital for the top 1%.
